births.label: Annual births
births.source: UN World Population Prospects 2019 (total fertility rate x women aged 15-49 / 35)
births.notes: Estimated for 2024 from the UN WPP 2019 medium variant: the total fertility rate multiplied by the number of women aged 15-49, divided by 35. Accurate to about 5 % for high-fertility countries and less so for low-fertility ones, where the fertility is concentrated in a few years of age. Replace with the national birth registration when it is available; that is the value the model should use.
